challenge.heading: Farming in Nigeria carries real risk
challenge.body: In Nigeria, food production is limited by erratic seasonal rains, high pest vulnerability, post-harvest losses, and disconnected local supply channels that impact farmers' income.

innovation.heading: Controlled environments that remove the guesswork
innovation.body: By growing inside engineered screen houses with drip irrigation and soilless media, Vera AgriTech's systems eliminate many of the risks of open-field farming — delivering 3x–5x higher yields on up to 90% less water.

financing.seoDescription: Vera AgriTech's Pay-As-You-Grow financing model, repayment structure and triple security model.

hero.heading: Pay-As-You-Grow — financing linked to your harvest
hero.body: We structure repayments based on your harvests to make modern, controlled-environment farming financially achievable.

affordableEntry.title: Affordable Entry
affordableEntry.description: Farmers contribute a 10%–20% initial down payment to begin installation.
affordableEntry.example: Example: Screen house cost = ₦2,000,000. Farmer pays ₦200,000 – ₦400,000 to begin.

productionLinkedRepayment.title: Production-Linked Repayment
productionLinkedRepayment.description: Repayment occurs after harvest, tied directly to crop sales.
productionLinkedRepayment.example: Example: Harvest sales = ₦500,000. Allocation: 60% to farmer, 30% to loan repayment, 10% to maintenance & insurance fund.

cropHedgedRepayment.title: Crop-Hedged Repayment System (Urban Farm Purchase Agreement – UFPA)
cropHedgedRepayment.description: Vera AgriTech is the first buyer of your produce. Repayment is deducted at source before the balance is paid to you.

tripleSecurity.title: Security Layer 1 — Produce Offtake
tripleSecurity.description: All produce is marketed through the company. Repayment is deducted at source.

tripleSecurity.title: Security Layer 2 — Equipment Ownership
tripleSecurity.description: Vera AgriTech retains ownership of the screen house, irrigation and hydroponic equipment until full repayment.

tripleSecurity.title: Security Layer 3 — Cooperative Guarantee
tripleSecurity.description: Farmers operate in clusters (e.g. 50 farmers per cluster) as cooperative members. Peer monitoring improves repayment.

additionalProtection.title: Additional Risk Protection — Urban Agriculture Insurance Fund
additionalProtection.description: 2% of sales value is saved to protect against disease outbreaks, storm damage, fire and water supply disruptions.

financing.disclaimer: The exact commercial terms, interest treatment and repayment calculations shown here are indicative examples pending final validation by the Vera AgriTech team, and will be confirmed before any agreement is signed.

faqs.question: What is soilless / hydroponic farming?
faqs.answer: Growing crops using inert substrates with soluble mineral nutrients, preventing soil-borne diseases and conserving water.

faqs.question: Why screen houses over traditional farming?
faqs.answer: UV-stabilized mesh netting excludes insect pests (up to 90% reduction), reduces reliance on insecticides, shields crops from heavy rain, and maintains a moderate microclimate.

faqs.question: Does Vera supply farm machinery?
faqs.answer: Yes — hand tillers, sprayers, harvesters, grow trays, drip fittings, water pumps and storage tanks.

faqs.question: How do I register for training?
faqs.answer: Contact us via the website form or WhatsApp. Workshops are held in Ibadan, with customized on-site options available.

faqs.question: How does the Pay-As-You-Grow financing work?
faqs.answer: You make an initial down payment (typically 10–20% of the package cost), and the remaining balance is repaid from a share of your harvest sales after each production cycle.

faqs.question: Who buys the produce?
faqs.answer: Vera AgriTech aggregates and markets produce to hotels, restaurants, supermarkets, hospitals, schools and food processors through its guaranteed offtake model.
